handoff.summary: lessons system: socom lesson (eval->lesson bridge), backlog #2 done
handoff.done:
Backlog #2 (lessons) shipped, gates green, pushed, CI verified green (headSha 6719d49 -> success). The second Akili->SOCOM extraction.
`socom lesson` (commit 116f5c1) + schemas/lesson.xml: - Lesson artifact: id/domain/state(provisional|active|retired)/source/ lifecycle attrs + embed-flagged statement/why/derived-from/evidence + validated counter. Lives at .socom/lessons/<id>.xml. - candidates: born provisional from the LATEST cycle's published hotspots (broken >= --min-broken, default 2), idempotent one-per-source-promise. The eval->lesson bridge the eval-gate canon already promised. - list (--domain/--state filters), promote (provisional->active), retire (->retired, sets <retire>, body never deleted). - Retrieval is FREE: lessons are XML under .socom/, so existing `socom index` (rglob .socom/**.xml) chunks them and the existing lifecycle filter hides state="retired" from query. No new retrieval code.
Contract (all checks PASS, evidence in 116f5c1 [test]): schema well-formed; seeded hotspots (P-HOT 2/3, P-COLD 2/2) -> 2 candidates born; re-run idempotent (0); promote->active + list --state filters; retire->retired preserved on disk; query surfaces active L-P-HOT, filters retired L-P-COLD. Full smoke green (8 new lesson assertions). doctor clean (source=fce8a0829b46, no canon change). CI green post-push.
Also at session open: resolved 2 amber commit-msg breaches from the prior session (HR3 loop-close) — early [test] blocks carried evidence in prose, not the $cmd/rc= shape; corrected from c405560 on.
handoff.undone: Deferred (scope discipline — ONE increment): lesson distillation is NOT wired into the closeout canon step (the command exists but the protocol ritual doesn't call it yet); auto-promote at validated>=N (list could suggest it); the validated counter is never incremented (no re-confirm path yet); ledger still has no auto-append, so cycles/lessons run on seeds not real operation. Dropped from the Akili port: vectors, confidence decay, consolidation, cold archival, contradiction edges.

handoff.warnings: - XML comments cannot contain '--' (double hyphen). The generated lesson template f-string had 'socom lesson retire ... --reason' in a comment, which made every born lesson malformed; `socom index` silently SKIPPED them (ParseError to stderr) so they never reached retrieval. Fixed by rewording the comment. Lesson distilled to memory this session. - .socom/index/chunks.jsonl shows as modified: the pre-push `full` check runs `socom index .` on the real repo, rewriting it. Pre-existing churn, not this work — left untouched (also breaches.resolved.log from the HR3 resolve). - `socom lesson candidates` reads only the LATEST cycle artifact; old hotspots in earlier cycles are not reconsidered. Fine for now.
